_comment: Chiral McKean-Vlasov SDE (non-conservative kernel K = rho*(-grad W) + omega*R90(-grad W), W = generalised Morse; omega=1.5, rho=0.2 -> NOT a Wasserstein gradient flow; the paper's intended failure mode). Pre-split train/test in data/chiral/chiral-simulation.npz (regenerate with data/chiral/generate.py). V-free: the radial interaction W_theta is the only learned functional (potential_coeff 0).
